result.title: FocusBranch: Combinatorial Branch-and-Bound for $\ell_0$ Neural Network Robustness Verification
result.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. 32 pages, 11 figures, 6 tables
result.summary: Verifying the local robustness of neural networks under $\ell_0$ perturbations is inherently combinatorial, as it must reason over all sparse subsets of $ε$ perturbed pixels. This paper presents FocusBranch, a combinatorial branch-and-bound framework for $\ell_0$ robustness verification. The key insight is to make the $\ell_0$-ball decomposable and branchable using a node abstraction, which consists of a focus pixel set $\mathcal{S}$ and a level $l$, permitting at most $ε-l$ pixels outside $\mathcal{S}$. This abstraction unifies two branching mechanisms: concrete nodes branch through upper shadows to fix additional perturbed locations, while super nodes branch through covering designs to cover many perturbation cases with fewer child nodes. FocusBranch proves node safety by concretizing linear relaxations over node-constrained $\ell_0$-balls and recursively branches on unknown nodes. Rather than relying on a fixed verification plan, it samples nodes across levels to estimate safe rates and costs, then selects a starting level and branching strategy predicted to minimize verification time. Experiments on fully connected and convolutional classifiers for MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10 show that FocusBranch verifies $\ell_0$ robustness effectively across architectures and outperforms state-of-the-art verifiers. The code is available at: https://github.com/simpl-group/FocusBranch.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FocusBranch，用「焦点像素集＋层级」的节点抽象把 ℓ0 扰动球分解为可分支结构，结合具体节点与超节点两种分支方式，并以线性松弛证明节点安全，同时采样估计各层安全率与代价来自动选择起始层级和分支策略。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按像素子集做组合式分支搜索、并用采样估计开销来选择搜索策略，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据子集筛选、计算预算分配与停止决策提供问题表述上的启发，需核查实际迁移空间。
